description: This Java source file defines the HomeListenerService class, which extends WearableListenerService to handle DataItem events on an Android wearable device. It manages notifications related to geofence triggers, including posting notifications when entering geofences and canceling them when data items are deleted.

classes.name: HomeListenerService
classes.description: A service that listens for DataItem events on a wearable device, handling geofence notifications and data item deletions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient and connects it when the service is created.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles DataItem events, posting notifications on geofence entry and canceling notifications on data deletion.

methods.name: cancelNotificationForDataItem
methods.description: Cancels the notification associated with a deleted DataItem.

methods.name: postNotificationForGeofenceId
methods.description: Posts a notification when a geofence is triggered, with options to check in or delete the data item.
